page: Vultr vcg-mi355x-252c-2872g-2304vram is a Dedicated Metal GPU server designed for extreme computational workloads. The system is powered by an x86_64 AMD CPU architecture providing 252 dedicated vCPUs. It features 2872.0 GB of system memory, which equates to approximately 11.4 GB of RAM per core.

The primary accelerator configuration consists of eight AMD MI355X GPUs built on the CDNA4 architecture, delivering a combined total of 2304 GB of VRAM. For local data storage, the server is equipped with 14336 GB of NVMe SSD capacity, providing high-speed local read and write capabilities. The network configuration includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Given the dense integration of eight high-capacity GPUs, massive system memory, and extensive NVMe storage, this bare-metal server represents a highly consolidated hardware profile. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for large-scale deployments that would otherwise require multiple smaller nodes, reducing clustering overhead. This configuration is engineered for heavy workloads such as large language model training, complex data science jobs, high-performance computing, and massive parallel database operations.
